scope: First recursion step m=4, including all repeated coordinates and partial sums at infinity. No proof of general m, irreducibility, individual symbolic degrees, signed standing or separate-host execution.
statement: For every nonsingular general Weierstrass model over an algebraically closed field in any characteristic, the actual fixed degree2/2 Mathlib Sylvester resultant of S3(x1,x2,T) and S3(x3,x4,T) vanishes exactly when four actual affine points with those prescribed x-coordinates sum to zero.
